description: Golden dataset for product-review triage: the sentiment a review carries and the topic it is about. Six cases per topic, spanning clear-cut and genuinely mixed language.

input.review_text: Ordered Tuesday, arrived Thursday morning. Two days door to door is genuinely impressive.
Package showed up nine days late and the tracking page never updated once.
Delivery was on the estimated date. Box was a little dented but nothing inside was damaged.

cases.notes: Minor complaint that does not tip the overall sentiment negative.

input.review_text: Courier left it in pouring rain on the porch instead of the covered step I asked for.

cases.notes: Handling complaint — still a shipping issue, not product quality.

input.review_text: Shipping cost more than I expected but it did get here in under 48 hours.

cases.notes: Mentions cost, but the subject is the shipment — topic must stay shipping.

input.review_text: Third order in a row that arrived exactly when the app said it would. Reliable.
The stitching came apart at the seam after two washes. Feels cheaply made.
Solid metal body, no flex at all, and the finish still looks new after six months.
Material is about what you would expect at this tier. Not premium, not bad.

cases.notes: Explicitly middling — a real neutral, not a hedged negative.

input.review_text: Mine arrived with a hairline crack in the casing, though the replacement has been flawless.

cases.notes: Defect plus recovery — mixed language that models often over-call as negative.

input.review_text: Buttons started sticking within a month. Second unit with the same fault.
Heavier and better finished than anything else I tried in this bracket.
Forty dollars for what is essentially a plastic bracket. Hard to justify.
Caught it during the sale and at that price it is honestly a steal.
Costs about the same as the competing model. Nothing remarkable either way.
Went up thirty percent since last year with no visible change to the product.
Built well enough that the premium over the budget option felt worth paying.

cases.notes: Mentions build quality but the judgement is about worth — topic is price.

input.review_text: The subscription renews at full price with no loyalty discount whatsoever.
Support replied in under an hour and had a replacement out the same day.
Four emails over two weeks and I still do not have an answer about my warranty.
Chat agent was polite and followed the script, but could not actually change my order.

cases.notes: Positive manner, unhelpful outcome — nets out neutral.

input.review_text: Phone line disconnected me twice before I reached anyone who could help.
The help centre article answered it in one page, so I never needed to contact anyone.

cases.notes: Self-service success still belongs to the support topic.

input.review_text: Standard returns process. Took the usual week to clear, no surprises.
